# abilities

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m uikit docs` from contracts/abilities.json - do not edit by hand. -->

Per-player ability bar: key, name, cooldown gauge, hold gauge. Tick-friendly.

C#: `AbilityLayout / IAbilityService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:abilities slots=4 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `slots` (default `4`): Tiles in the pool (AbilityLayout.Slots).

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `slots`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="ab_bar"` | panel | yes | `style-*` | The bar. Style = accent. |
| `id="ab_{n}"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `cooldown`, `holding`, `blocked` | A tile. Author it `hidden`. |
| `id="ab_{n}_bar"` | panel | no | `cd-N`, `run` | Recharge gauge: `cd-N` = N seconds (1..MaxCooldownSeconds), `run` fills it. |
| `id="ab_{n}_hold"` | panel | no | `hold-N`, `run` | Hold gauge: `hold-N` = N tenths of a second (by HoldStepTenths), `run` fills it. |
| `text="{s:ab_{n}_key}"` | Label text | yes | string | AbilitySlot.Key |
| `text="{s:ab_{n}_name}"` | Label text | yes | string | AbilitySlot.Name |
| `text="{s:ab_{n}_cd}"` | Label text | no | string | Seconds left, while `cooldown` |
| `text="{s:ab_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | AbilityBarOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.hidden`, `.cooldown`, `.holding`, `.run`, `.cd-1`, `.hold-5`, `.style-neutral`.
